agentGuidance.summary: Read this manifest before using any file in public/assets/. Prefer webReady assets (typically .webp or lightweight .svg) for web pages. Never embed multi-megabyte gallery/ masters directly in production HTML/CSS — create an optimised .webp derivative first.

routes.signature: Route 01 — Signature ribbons (petrol teal dominant, oxblood secondary, selective metallic gold, luminous nodes)
routes.quiet: Route 02 — Quiet ribbons (simplified 2-3 broad ribbons without gold filaments, minimal texture and glow)
routes.gold: Route 03 — Gold filaments and flares (fine warm-gold threads and small crisp flares only, no filled ribbons)

assets.visualDescription: Primary dark evening-luxe hero background artwork rasterised for web delivery.
assets.recommendedUse: Homepage and concept hero backgrounds.
assets.avoidUse: Print or large-format export (use hero-background.png or an approved master instead).

assets.visualDescription: Earlier concept mark: gold gradient linked nodes with three glowing curved arcs.
assets.recommendedUse: Legacy concept reference only.
assets.avoidUse: Primary site headers or new brand work — docs/brand-guidelines.md specifies Route 5 (Woven IC) as the canonical mark.

assets.visualDescription: Horizontal strip of four gold line icons with subtle glow representing: (1) assess (connected network nodes), (2) strategise (concentric target rings), (3) enable (stacked isometric layers), (4) realise (rising bar chart with upward arrow).
assets.recommendedUse: Methodology/service strip on dark surfaces.
assets.avoidUse: Light paper backgrounds without recolouring (gold gradient lacks WCAG contrast on light paper).

assets.visualDescription: Tileable subtle SVG noise/grain overlay for tactile surface depth.
assets.recommendedUse: Low-opacity CSS background overlay on dark ink or warm paper sections.
assets.avoidUse: High opacity that degrades text legibility.

assets.visualDescription: Core CSS custom properties for colour palette, typography, spacing, and borders.

assets.visualDescription: Base layout, typography defaults, and shared page sections.

assets.visualDescription: Signature ribbon with three horizontal streams converging smoothly into one outgoing flow on a transparent background.

assets.recommendedUse: Restrained framing around callouts or editorial stats.

assets.visualDescription: Quiet ribbon (no gold filaments) with three horizontal streams merging into one on a transparent background.
assets.recommendedUse: Supporting slides and diagrams for alignment and adoption workflows.

assets.visualDescription: Quiet ribbon (no gold filaments) sweeping diagonally from bottom-left to top-right on a transparent background.
assets.recommendedUse: Subtle supporting hero or section background where text dominates.

assets.visualDescription: Compact quiet ribbon (no gold filaments) in a small bottom-right diagonal corner flourish on a transparent background.
assets.recommendedUse: Lightweight corner accent for everyday slides and white or dark documents.

assets.visualDescription: Gold filaments only (no solid ribbons) sweeping diagonally from bottom-left to top-right on a transparent background.
assets.recommendedUse: Open, airy framing and document/slide backgrounds.

assets.visualDescription: Sparser gold filaments only (less decoration than v01) sweeping diagonally from bottom-left to top-right on a transparent background.
assets.recommendedUse: Minimal editorial framing and quiet light or dark backgrounds.
